name: a flat dry plain with one straight road and kilometre posts under a stormy sky
fits: anything measured along the ground: the delay of thunder after lightning, an echo, a race of light and sound, distance by counting seconds; the hero is the storm at the far end of the road
recipe: a sky of stacked grey tones, a flat sand ground from the horizon down with no hills, trees, sea or fields, one asphalt slab running along the iso x axis with dashes, kilometre posts as iso blocks, dry tufts as dressing, sound rings as ground ellipses
